name: Working of the Old Crown
description: A quarry bench of the realm before the roads, still being worked. The Hewers never received the order to stop: the benches are swept, the half-cut blocks stand square in their cradles, and the crane footings are kept clear for a crane that rotted before your grandmother's grandmother. There is no fire anywhere on the ground, because stone does not need to see. Interrupt the shift at your own cost.

signs.title: THE ROLLS
lines: a tally scored into the bench face
the count is current to this morning
